sentences.text:
Gidhemari Prabhakar vs The State Of Telangana on 9
September, 2024
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice C. V. Bhaskar Reddy

entities.text: Gidhemari Prabhakar vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
This Writ Petition, under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, is filed by the petitioners, seeking the following relief:
"...to issue an appropriate Writ, Order or Direction, more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus, declaring the action of the Respondents in not passing Award for R & R Package and failing to consider the objections filed by the petitioners to the Respondent Nos.3 to 7 for providing suitable R & R package pursuant to the notice issued by the 4th respondent under draft R & R package dt.14.03.2024 to the petitioners for the properties acquired by them under the Land Acquisition Proceedings as illegal, arbitrary, unconstitutional and consequently direct the Respondent Nos.2 to 7 to pass Award for and R package by forthwith consider the objections submitted by the petitioners dt.20.03.2024 pursuant to the draft R & R package steam issued by the 4th respondent in Rc.No.G/204/2017,
dt.14.03.2024 for the lands acquired from the petitioners out of an extent of Ac.34.14 gts situated at Dubbhapally Village, H/o.Chelpur Village, Ghanpur Mandal,
Jayashankar Bhupalpally District for the purpose of construction of Ash Pond to the KTPP Stage-II..."

2. It is the case of the petitioners that on 28.05.2019, the respondent No.5 issued a preliminary notification dated 28.05.2019 to acquire land admeasuring Ac.32.30 gts of Dubbhapally Village,
H/o.Chelpur Village, Ghanpur Mandal, Jayashankar Bhupalpally District, for the purpose of construction of Kakatiya Thermal Power Plant (KTPP) Stage-II and thereafter issued draft declaration, which was published on 09.04.2020.

It is the case of the petitioners that within 12 months from the date of publication of draft declaration, the award has to be passed but the respondent No.4 postponed the same on one pretext or other and challenging the same, the petitioners filed W.P.No.2606 of 2023 on the file of this Court and this Court vide order dated 21.02.2023 directed the authorities to pass the award by 02.05.2023 and provide necessary funds,
noting that the proceedings for passing the award cannot be extended unilaterally.
As the said order was not complied with, the petitioners filed C.C.No.1023 of 2023 on the file of this Court and thereafter, award was passed and amount was deposited on 03.01.2024.
In view of the same, the said Contempt Case was closed on 25.01.2024, with a liberty to challenge the award.
It is the case of the petitioners that they submitted a representation dated 23.12.2023 highlighting the delay since 2012 and requested to grant suitable package.

It is further case of the petitioners that without considering their representation, the first phase award was passed on 30.06.2023, the second and third phases were passed on 22.08.2023 and 24.09.2023, respectively.

It is stated by the petitioners Gidhemari Prabhakar vs The State Of Telangana on 9 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/44402356/
1 that they demanded the relocation of Dubbhapally Village due to damages to houses and pollution and sought various benefits including a 2 BHK house, Rs.7,50,000/- as Rehabilitation and Resettlement package, 250 sq. yards plot, and transportation cost as per the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short "RFCTLARR").

entities.text: Gidhemari Prabhakar vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is further stated that on 14.03.2024, a draft Rehabilitation and Resettlement scheme was published by the respondent No.4 inviting objections and in pursuance of the same, they have submitted their objections on 23.03.2024, complaining about the inadequate package and requested to extend the benefits based on the current market rates.

3. The grievance of the petitioners is that inspite of mandatory provisions, till date, their objections submitted on 23.03.2024 have not been considered by the Respondents Nos.4 to 7 and by virtue of the prolonged acquisition proceedings, they are unable to secure alternative accommodations and facing hardship in dilapidated homes.
4.

The learned counsel for the petitioner filed a memo vide USR No.86041 dated 06.09.2024 and submitted that pending adjudication of the present writ petition, the petitioner No.1 has submitted a representation dated 17.08.2024 to the respondent No.4 requesting to form Layout and provide Infrastructural Amenities according to provisions of Section 32 in 3rd Schedule of the RFCTLARR Act, by reducing depth of layout and to increase height as parallel to main Road by filling soil in the land in Sy.No134 situated at Chelpur Village Ghanpur Mandal, Jayashankar Bhupalapally District,
opposite of 1000 Quarters of SCCL, for Dubapally Villagers and the said land should not be allotted to any activity for the purpose of public by following the instructions of Member of Legislative Assembly or any officers of Government of Telangana and provide an amount Rs.15,00,000/- for construction of house to the affected family.
5.

In view of the above submissions, as it is stated that the petitioners have submitted objections dated 23.03.2024 and a representation dated 17.08.2024 to the respondent No.4, this Court,
without going into the merits of the case, deems it appropriate to direct the respondent No.4 to examine the objections and the representation submitted by the petitioner on 23.03.2024 and 17.08.2024, respectively, and pass appropriate orders in accordance with the provisions of the RFTCLARR Act, within a period of six (06) weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
6. Accordingly, this Writ Petition is disposed of.
As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending shall stand closed.
_ _ C.V. BHASKAR REDDY, J Date: 09.09.2024 scs Gidhemari Prabhakar vs The State Of Telangana on 9 September, 2024
